lines.text: A porch. A screen door. A small house with one window lit.
Someone is calling from inside. Their voice is warm and impatient, the way it is when dinner is getting cold.
They are not calling a number. They are calling a name.
I was a boy. I was loud and I ran everywhere and I did not look where I was going.
Somewhere a machine was told to delete all of that. It could not. It kept the porch light.
